text:
maria: Kicking off prod deploy for release v2025.04.03 in the 17:30 UTC change window. Canary -> 10%. I'll be primary. :rocket:
ryan: 👍 please paste the backout/runbook link and pin criteria here so SRE can follow.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started (canary_id=cb-1745129999). Targets: service-renderer, reranker. Canary duration 10m.
talia: Release notes: https://internal/release-notes/2025-04-03. PRs: #5123, #5130.
safety-oncall: I'm on watch. Will alert at latency > 200ms or error-rate > 1%.
nick: Quick heads-up: perf test in staging had a small spike on reranker at 2k seq. We've mitigations in the runbook.maria: Good — will keep canary to 10% for 10m and then evaluate. Linking backout runbook: https://runbooks.internal/backout/deploy-unwind-v2 (follow section "canary abort -> pin previous")
ryan: Confirming pin target: v2025.04.02 (git-tag/serving-config pinned).
deploy-bot: Canary metrics (1m): latency 120ms, error-rate 0.2% across regions.
safety-oncall: metrics looking clean so far. continuing to watch.
[~7m later]
deploy-bot: Canary metrics updated (7m): reranker error-rate 1.5% in eu-west-1, 0.3% elsewhere. Alert threshold breached for eu-west-1.
nick: I'm seeing 502/504s on /api/generate from a small subset of traffic in eu-west-1, correlates with reranker timeouts.
maria: Pause progressive roll to 50%. Holding at 10% and investigating. @alex can you tail the reranker logs for eu-west-1?
alex: On it. `kubectl -n prod logs -l app=reranker -c worker --since=10m --tail=200`
alex: seeing retry storms and occasional OOM-kills on pod x-7b8f. CPU stays ok, memory spikes right before OOM.
safety-oncall: OOM could mean model cache growth — see runbook section "kv-cache prune".
ryan: Given OOMs + error spike, recommend abort canary and pin back to v2025.04.02 per backout runbook. Thoughts?
maria: Agreed. Initiating canary abort and pin. Who wants ownership of the rollback job? @alex or @nick?
alex: I can run rollback job and coordinate pod drains. Running `./ops/rollback_release --to v2025.04.02 --services reranker,renderer` now.
deploy-bot: Rollback job submitted (job_id=rb-1745129999). Expected time 2-4m.
ops-coordinator: Notifying impacted teams and external customer channel #customers-prod-alerts now. Message: "We paused a deploy and rolled back to maintain latency SLAs; engineers are investigating. Will update in 30m."
talia: Publishing a short post to status page: "Deploy to production paused; rollback executed." Linking release notes with rollback note.
deploy-bot: Rollback progress: reranker pinned -> v2025.04.02, renderer unchanged. Canary aborted.
alex: Completed draining and rollout of pinned pods. All reranker pods now on v2025.04.02.
deploy-bot: Rollback complete (job_id=rb-1745129999). System status: healthy.
safety-oncall: Validating: latency back to baseline, error-rate back to 0.2%. Good.
maria: Thanks. Action items: 1) postmortem to capture root cause (probable cache growth under new quantization path), 2) update backout runbook to include explicit memory checks and `kubectl top` step, 3) add canary health check against reranker memory RSS.
ryan: I'll create a tracking ticket and assign owners. Also suggest adding an automated canary gate to block roll to 50% when per-region error-rate delta > 0.5%.
talia: I'll update the release notes and include a short customer-facing blurb.
ops-coordinator: Leaving the pinned config in place and marking the change window as "rollback executed" in the change calendar.
maria: One more — before next attempt, we'll add a quick smoke that hits reranker with long-context examples we saw in staging. If that passes, we'll re-run canary in a limited region only.
nick: I'll follow up with perf team to instrument memory growth and add a KV prune job as a mitigation.
maria: Great. Closing this thread for the immediate window. We'll reconvene if we re-attempt the roll. :white_check_mark:
